test_title: PYST 29: SSC CHSL - Reasoning (Held On: 2 June 2022 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Two different positions of the same dice are shown, the six faces of which are marked from A to F. Select the letter that will be on the face opposite to the one showing 'D'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b3e0c069c5fea300246c0112b57ee4eb1fa0a2f93ecaf7b77c0d45936afa4fb9.png]
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b3e0c069c5fea300246c0112b57ee4eb1fa0a2f93ecaf7b77c0d45936afa4fb9.png] 

E and C are common in both the dices.

Clearly, **F** will be on the face opposite to **D**.

Hence,** 'option 1'** is the correct answer.
